test.title: The tallest tree in the valley

paragraphs.text: A fir measured last autumn turned out to be 62 metres tall, the tallest recorded in the valley. It stands on private land, and the owner has asked that its exact position is not published.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Foresters believe the tree is about 250 years old. Its top was damaged in a storm in 2018 but has since recovered, and the tree is expected to keep growing for several decades.
paragraphs.label: B

document.title: The tallest tree in the valley

items.quote: the tallest recorded in the valley
items.prompt: The fir is the tallest tree in the country.

explanation.en: The text says the tallest in the valley, not the country → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Мәтінде — ел емес, аңғардағы ең биік ағаш → FALSE.
explanation.ru: В тексте — самое высокое дерево долины, а не страны → FALSE.

items.quote: the owner has asked that its exact position is not published
items.prompt: Visitors are told where the tree grows.

explanation.en: The owner asked that the position not be published → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Владелец просил не публиковать место → FALSE.

items.quote: the tree is about 250 years old
items.prompt: The tree is more than 200 years old.

explanation.en: About 250 years is more than 200 → TRUE.

items.quote: Its top was damaged in a storm in 2018
items.prompt: The storm of 2018 damaged several trees in the valley.

explanation.en: Only this tree is mentioned; other trees in the storm are not → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Тек осы ағаш туралы айтылған; дауылдағы басқа ағаштар туралы ештеңе жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Сказано только про это дерево; о других деревьях в бурю ничего нет → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
